Distin1971.method: Levitated iron in equilibrium with liquid iron oxide; sampled metal and oxide.
Distin1971.uncertainty_scope: Abstract reports ±0.02 wt%; confidence level and individual covariance unavailable.

Frost2010.locator: Section4.1, Eqs6–9, PDFpage7; visually checked original equations.
Frost2010.pressure_fit_conditions: 12–24.5GPa,2373–2473K coexistence; ambient mixing inherited from KowalskiSpencer1995; FeO1.5 neglected above2000K.

limitations: Measured high-temperature saturation excludes a claim that2173K Fe–O has no direct binary evidence.
The Distin binary saturation fit does not certify arbitrary Fe–Si–O–H or13-element alloy stability.
The Frost two-associated-species approximation has visible residuals against the3 Distin measurements, larger than reported0.02wt% at some points; it is not silently treated as exact.
Only composition-dependent binary activity after equal infinite-dilution anchors is compared to Ma; this does not establish agreement of absolute standards.
Reported pressure term is excess mixing only. Pure-component pressure volumes and Si/H effects are not included and must not be declared bounded by it.
Neither a common empirical material domain nor a complete multicomponent phase-stability result is established.
